findings.analysis: The task-specific ReadDocument manifest loaded from the exact public Sydney development service in a signed-in Word Online session.
The first Office dialog released no Word summary because the Diary did not admit the hosted companion capability. No backend, database, credential or provider fallback occurred.

The repair admits only smoke and reception_one_companion_demo when the exact origin-bound authored-synthetic policy and all seven false authority fields validate. Other harness and product capabilities remain closed.
The post-repair request reached the native Diary, produced three authored-synthetic matches, passed the existing deterministic summary proofreader and returned only the generic result count to Word.
Synthetic appointment detail remained visible only in the native Diary. Word contained neither the synthetic patient detail nor the request text.
Observed taskpane and Diary resource timing contained zero API, credential or provider requests. No document-body, database, command, confirmation or microphone path ran.

Both task-created blank documents were moved to the recoverable OneDrive Recycle Bin, task-created browser tabs were closed and local build, image, container, network and temporary Docker credential residue is zero.

proves: Task-specific manifest loading in one signed-in personal Word Online session.
One bounded authored-synthetic Word-to-Diary typed exchange.
Native-Diary-only detail and generic proofreader-admitted Word release.
The exact public service repair and observed zero-authority network posture.
does_not_prove: EMR4 application authentication or clinician-role authorization.
Organisational Office tenant deployment or central add-in administration.
Safety for real, product-derived, patient, health, clinical or historical data.
Backend, database, provider, microphone, appointment command or document-write readiness.
Microsoft or Google physical or sovereign processing location.

explicit_exclusions: No raw request or raw response is retained.
No account, tenant, document URL, document identifier or filename is retained.
No credential, cookie, token or authentication response was inspected or persisted.
No provider reasoning or chain-of-thought exists in this provider-free exercise.
